note: Wikimedia Commons, “St. Calliope, Martyr Met DP890991.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Jacques Callot — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: The Metropolitan Museum's own title for the print, which Commons carries, is St Calliope, Martyr. The calendar keeps one Calliope, the virgin martyr of 8 June, which is this folder's Greek feast and this folder's rank; The plate is from Callot's Les Images de Tous les Saints and is lettered on the picture itself «S. CALLIOPE MAR.» with «8» and «Juni» in the lower corners — 8 June, the day read out of this folder's Greek attestation.
